title: How the claims list pages through long lists

fields.summary: How should the claims list page through long lists? The list is being built now (Feature #20).
fields.options:
1. Numbered pages
2. A Load more button
fields.evaluation: Numbered pages let caseworkers return to a position in a long list. Load more is simpler for claimants, who have few claims.
fields.recommendation: Numbered pages, because caseworkers return to positions in long lists.
